tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gnyan sgrol yan lag drug pa'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa blo dman 'jug bde bzhugs so// na mo gu ru ār+ya tā ra ye/ thugs rje'i bdag nyid shes rab dngos/ /dpal ldan ma der phyag 'tshal nas/ /gang gi sgrub thabs rjes gnang bcas/ /shin tu gsal ba'i ngag gis bshad/ /'phags pa klu sgrub dang sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs sogs nas brgyud pa'i rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras kyi thugs dam gnyan gyi sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa bya tshul ni/ gnas dben par stegs bu khebs ldan la mañji sogs kyi steng maṇ+ḍal la dri bzang gi thig le zlum skor gyi khar nas 'bras sogs kyi tshom bu che chung ci rigs gcig de'i mdun du zlum gtor/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ sbreng tshar/ rang nyid stan la 'dug pa'i drung rdor dril/ 'thor nas/ slob ma la dgos pa'i maṇ+ḍal 'thor nas chab bum bcas bshams/ 'di bla med yin pas rdor dkar ni mi dgos/ mchod pa rnams la rdo rje gsor zhing / oṃ a mṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhāḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams gang bar gyur/ oṃ ar+gha/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shap+ta aḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dharma ra ṇi ta pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra pra tsa li ni/ pradz+nyā pa ra mi ta nā da swa bhā we na badz+ra dharma hri da ya ni san+to ṣa ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho ā khaṃ swāhā/ tshar gsum la dri bsil rol mo dang bcas pas mchod pa byin brlabs nas/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/

/rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das༞ dam pa'i chos rnams༞ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun༞ zhes pa lan nyi shu rtsa gcig thal mo sbyar la/ bdag gzhan 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i bsgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /zhes lan gsum brjod/ rang skad cig gis rje btsun mar gsal ba'i thugs kar paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tāṃ ljang gu de las 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma dang rje btsun ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs de la/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ghan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa rnams phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod/ thal mo sbyar te/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /lan gsum brjod/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig ces lan gcig brjod pas tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/

snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyi mi dmigs pa'i stong nyid 'od gsal gyi nam mkha' lta bur gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems nyid gnyis su med pa'i ye shes rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba sgyu mar snang ba de nyid tāṃ las ut+pal ljang gu tāṃ gyis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod sems can kyi don byas tshur 'dus tāṃ yig ut+pal dang bcas pa la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rje btsun ma sgrol ma sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas pas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad cing / g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis ut+pa la'i rtsa ba thugs kar bzung ste 'dab ma snyan gyi thad kar bye ba/ zhal 'dzum zhing rab tu zhi ba/ dbu skra li ba g.yon phyogs su brdzes shing g.yas ngos nas mar cung zad 'phyang ba/ lo bcu drug lon pa lta bu'i cha lugs can/ zla ba la sku rgyab brten pa/ dar srab mo'i stod g.yogs kyis nu ma bkab cing / dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs gsol ba/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas cung zad brkyang zhing / g.yon bskum pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs kar paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tāṃ yig ljang gu de las 'od zer 'phros pas po tā la nas rje btsun ma sgrol ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐ bar gong bzhin/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /bcom ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams/ /thugs rje'i rang bzhin can rnams kyi/ /khyed kyis bdag la dbang bskur stsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis khrus bya'o/

/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka tā sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa bdud rtsi gang bas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las spyi bor don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ dbang gi lha de rnams rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i skur gyur te rang la gnyis su med par thim/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ de nas ut+pa la'i phyag rgya bcing bar bya ste thal mo sbyar la mdzub mo gnyis kyis gung mo gnyis kyi sen mo bkab ste srin lag gnyis nang du bcug pa mthe bong mnan pa ni ut+pa la kha phye ba ste 'dis dpral ba/ mgrin pa dang / snying ga dpung gong gnyis te gnas lngar gtug cing / oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re swāhā/ zhes tshar re brjod lha sku snang la rang bzhin med pa la sems yun ring du gtad/ spro na/ thugs kar tāṃ yig gi mthar yi ge bcu pa kha dog dkar po mgo gyen du blta bas bskor bar gyur/ de la klog pa'i tshul du/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swāhā/ zhes yi ge bcu pa gtso bor bzlas/ spro na/ na maḥ.ar+ya a wa lo ki te shwa rā ye/ bo dhi satwa ya/ ma hā satwa ya/ ma hā ka ru ṇi kā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re ma ma kri te sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ pra duṣ+ṭaṃ/ dzaṃ bha ya/ staṃ bha ya/ mo ha ya/ ban+dha ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ satwaṃ bha ni tā re swāhā/ zhes gzungs ring ci nus bzlas/ bcom ldan 'das mas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur te rang la thim/ tshom bu la rdo rje gsor te/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tāṃ las ut+pa la ljang gu zhes pa nas/ dbu rgyan/ zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin la/ dbang gi lha de rnams rje btsun sgrol ma'i skur gyur te gnyis su med par thim/

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ mchod pa bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs gong bzhin la/ dharma ra ṇi mi dgos/ oṃ ar+ya tā ra a pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yaṃ nas/ shap+ta pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ 'di bar rigs 'gre dril gsil/ dharma ra ṇi nas/ lha dang lha min cod paṇa gyis/ /zhabs kyi pad+mo la btud de/ /phongs pa kun las sgrol mdzad ma/ /sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa tsam mam/ yang na/ glog dang 'dra ba'i spyan mnga' ma/ /nas/ mtha' bral zung 'jug sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bar/ gtor ma/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum brjod la/ na maḥsarba bud+dha bo dhi satwa naṃ a pra ti ha ta sha sa nā naṃ hai/ bha ga wa ti ma hā satwa sarba bud+dha a ba lo ni ma bi laṃ pa/ ma bi laṃ pa/ i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa pa ya sarba bi sañca re ye swāhā/ oṃ ār+ya tā ra a sogs mchod pa dang / lha dang lha min sogs bstod pa gong bzhin/ bcom ldan 'das mas bdag dang sems can thams cad 'jigs pa chen po brgyad dang bcu drug las bskyab tu gsol/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral du gsol/ byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems khyad par can rgyud la skye zhing myur du rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ mdun bskyed la dmigs te/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re sogs yi ge bcu pa phreng 'khor dang / gzungs ring 'dod gsol bcas bdag bskyed bzhin/ slob ma rnams kyis chab dang yon phul/ maṇ+ḍal gyi nas gral 'go nas bkye/ gral gsham nas bsdu tshar ba dang / slob dpon gyis/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rjes su gnang ba zab mo gsan la don nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa gsal btab ste gsan par zhu/

de la 'dir bdag cag gi ston pa tshad med pa'i thugs rje can des gsungs pa'i dam pa'i chos rnams bsdu na mdo sngags gnyis las/ sngags kyi theg par rgyud sde bzhi bzhugs pa'i bla med rgyud du gtogs pa rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i skor yin/ de la yang lugs srol mang du yod pa las 'dir bde ba can gyi 'jig rten du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag tu med pas 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas pa sangs rgyas gzhan gyi zhing khams su mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa las/ mi mjed kyi 'jig rten 'dir yang skyes pas 'dul ba la spyan ras gzigs/ bud med kyi 'dul ba la rje btsun sgrol mar sprul nas sems can gyi don mdzad pa yin no/ /de la 'dzam bu'i gling gi lho phyogs ri bo gru 'dzin zhes bya ba'i steng na ār+ya lo ke shwa ra 'khor lha las lhus che ba la chos gsungs la/ 'og na ni rje btsun ma sgrol ma 'khor klu dang lha ma yin las lhus che ba la chos gsungs te/ sprul pa'i sku'i gtso bo gnyis de na bzhugs so/ /gzhan yang ri de na sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa bo dhi satwa du mas gang nas bzhugs so zhes 'byung ngo / /ri der sangs rgyas kyis sgrol ma'i rgyud kyang gsungs te/ sgrol ma rgya mtsho'i rgyud ces bya ba tsam gyis sems can gyi don byas nas/ ma 'ongs pa'i sems can la 'khor bar mi 'gyur ba'i phyir rgya mtshor nub bo/ /de'i rjes su rgya mtsho'i rgyud chung zhig gsungs nas yang de bzhin du nub bo/ /de nas ma 'ongs pa'i don du sgrol ma mngon par 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i rgyud dang / spyan ras gzigs ku ru kul+le zhes bya'i rtogs pa gsungs so/ /de la mngon par 'byung ba'i rgyud la brten nas slob dpon klu sgrub kyis sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs mdzad de/ sems can rnams la rgya cher bstan to/ /slob dpon klu sgrub kyis slob ma ba ling ta pa la/

des sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs la/ des mar me mdzad bzang po la/ des dpal sde la/ des bi ma la gup+ta la/ des rin chen rdo rje la/ des rat+na kit+ti la/ des pan+da pa chen po la/ de la gnyen lo tsā bas gsan pa'i tshul ni bla ma gnyan lo tsā ba de chung dus nas rgya gar du byon yang / gzhon pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis slob gnyer drag po yang ma mdzad par ltad mo ka mdzad re zhig na mtsho gcig gi mtha' na sgo nga khrad zig ge ba cig 'dug pa bton nas khyer/ mtsho kha na shing lo gcig rlung gis khyer nas mtsho nang du song ba de nya gcig gis khyer mtsho gting du song ba dang / skad cig ling zer ba gcig byung ba rna bar zhen te/ nang du slebs pa na'ang / pig ling pig ling bzlas pas/ slob dpon ma ti'i zhal nas/ bu shing lo nya khyer skad cig byung / de ring gar phyin shod cig ma bshad na nyes pa chen po gcig byung dogs yod gsungs/ de rnams bshad pas ma legs so/ /dug sbrul gyi sgo nga yin/ da kho yong gsungs nas/ sdong po la khog grus pa'i nang du slob dpon dgongs pa la mnyam par bzhag lo tsā ba sgrol ma'i sku rgyab tu bzhag zangs chen la gla rtsi byugs pa'i nang du nye gnas sbas te bzhugs pa'i tshe mtshan mo ji zhig na dug sbrul byung ste/ slob dpon ni ma mthong / lo tsā ba'i g.yon nas nyul zhing / lces nyug nyug mang po byas kyang sgrol mas bskyabs pas gnod ma nus/ nam langs kyi bar zangs la gla rtsi byugs kyang de la 'khyud nas/ zangs kyi 'og gi nye gnas kyi lus sbang zan zhig pa ltar song / lo tsā ba bod du byon dus sgrol ma de bla ma dpyad zhus pas ma gnang bar bsnams nas byon/ gtsang chu mig sgrol mar grags pa lo tsā ba 'jigs pa brgyad ka las bskyabs so de lta bu'i byin rlabs can de snga thog gtsang chu mig gtsug lag khang dang / phyis su de la chos 'khor gnas na bzhugs par grags kyang deng sang gar bzhugs ni kho bos ma rtogs gong ltar gnyen lo tsā bas kha'u pa dang sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po gnyis la gnang /

de nas rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ byang chub dpal/ bde ba dpal/ grags pa gzhon nu/ bsod nams grags pa/ grags pa tshul khrims/ shes rab rdo rje/ brag bzang pa/ byang chub seng ge ye shes rgyal mtshan/ kun dga' bzang po/ kun dga' dbang phyug dkon mchog 'phel/ dkon mchog lhun grub/ nam mkha' dpal bzang / dpal ldan don grub/ bsod nams mchog ldan/ ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho/ phrin las rnam rgyal/ blo gros dbang phyug gnas gsar rdo rje 'chang kun dga' legs pa'i bar du byon pa dang / ming brgyud rim snga ma rnams gong bzhin la/ dkon mchog 'phel nas/ lha mchog seng ge sangs rgyas seng ge kun dga' lung rig sbyin pa grags pa/ sa skya pa a mes zhabs kun dga' bsod nams/ bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ kun dga' dpal 'byor/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ thar rtse rdo rje 'chang nam mkha' bsam 'grub gyi bar du byon pa dang / gzhan yang gong gi brgyud pa de dag la bla ma 'ga' zhig bzhugs pa dang ma bzhugs pa sogs brgyud pa'i rnam grangs phran bu dang bcas pa las nye bar brgyud pa'i rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i rjes su gnang ba la slob dpon gyi bgyi bar 'os pa rnams grub nas khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba zhu/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi sogs tshom bu bdun pa tshig lhug gam yang na/ sa gzhi spos kyis byugs shing sogs gang rigs/ tshig lhug ltar na/ zhu ba'i yon du zhes dang / de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar te de'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /lhag pa'i lha yi ngo bo nyid/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' drin gyis/ /bdag la rjes gnang stsal du gsol/ /de ltar gsol ba btab nas rgyud dag par bya ba'i phyir/ mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal gyi tshom bu 'di rje btsun mar bskyed pa la skyabs gnas thams cad kyis bskor ba'i drung khyed rang rnams 'khod nas sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa yan lag bdun pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/

dkon mchog gsum nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /de nas rjes gnang gzhi 'god pa'i slad du slob dpon la rje btsun ma dngos yin snyam pa'i mos pa byas pas de'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis mdun bskyed kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ thugs ka nas 'od zer ljang gu dpag tu med pa 'phros te slob ma'i lus la phog pas sdig sgrib dang bar du gcod pa thams cad sbyangs nas lus 'od kyi rang bzhin du gyur/ de'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du taṃ las ut+pal tāṃ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las khyed rang rnams rje btsun ma sgrol ma sku mdog ljang gu zhes pa nas/ g.yon bskum pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ bar bdag bskyed bzhin/ slar slob dpon la mos gus byas pas thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis mdun bskyed dang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs ka nas rje btsun ma'i sku bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs te khyed rang rnams la thim/ rdo rje g.yab dril bu bsil/ slob ma rnams gu gul gyis bdug la sngags ring thung bzlas/ dril bsil spos bdug bzhag la/ de rnams ni rjes gnang gi gzhi 'god pa yin/ dngos gzhi la gsum las dang po rjes su bzlas pa'i lung ni/ slob dpon la rje btsun mar mos pa byas la 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ slob dpon khyed kyis bdag la rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa'i lung dang / sngags kyi rjes su gnang ba ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sngags phreng sa bon dang bcas pa las de 'dra ba du ma byung ba zhal nas thon/ slob ma'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar zla ba la tāṃ yig gi mthar 'khod par mos pa byas la sngags 'di nyid kyi rjes zlos lan gsum re mdzod/

oṃ tā re sogs yi ge bcu pa dang / na maḥ.ar+ya sogs gzungs ring lan gsum/ de nas mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa'i lung bya ba la/ thog mar gling bzhi 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda' ste/ dpal ldan yid 'ong gru 'dzin na/ /zhes pa nas/ chos la rjes su yi rangs gyis bar slob dpon gyis tshar gcig brjod/ de nas khyed rang rnams 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ oṃ dge ba nas/ dpal ldan 'jig rten dbang bdag sras/ /bar lan gsum/ de nas slob dpon gyis phan yon brjod pa 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda' ste/ yon tan mtha' yas sgrol ma'i mtshan nas dge ba can ma'i bstod pa rdzogs so/ /bar lan gcig brjod klog gang rung / de nas khyed rang rnams slob dpon la me tog 'thor bzhin pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyis/ /bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ /slob dpon gyis khyed rang rnams la me tog gtor nas/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi/ /bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes lan gsum brjod pa ni/ rjes su bzlas pa'i lung yin/ gnyis pa dam bca' ba'i lung ni/ byang chub ma thob kyi bar du rje btsun ma yi dam du bzung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du rje btsun ma sgrol ma yi dam gyi lhar bzung bar bgyi'o/ /zhes lan gsum dang / slob dpon gyis/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs sh+lau ka gcig dang / rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi rgyud la rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig ces brjod cing me tog gtor ba ni dam bca' ba'i lung yin/ gsum pa byin gyis brlabs pa'i lung ni/ mdun bskyed kyi rje btsun ma la gus 'dud drag po byas pa'i rkyen gyis thugs ka nas de 'dra ba'i rje btsun ma mthe bong tsam zhig byon te/

khyed rang rnams kyi spyi gtsug nas zhugs thugs ka'i tāṃ yig dang dbyer med du 'dres pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon gyis me tog gtor te/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol mas rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams gnas skabs su 'jigs pa chen po brgyad dam bcu drug las bskyabs te 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las bsgral du gsol/ mthar thug mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod pa ni byin gyis brlab pa'i lung yin/ de ltar lung gsum gyi sgo nas rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i rjes gnang gsan pa yin pas dam tshig srung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi/ /rjes gnang thob pa'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ zhes dang maṇ+ḍal tshig lhug bcad gang rung gong bzhin la lhug pa ltar na/ thob pa'i yon du 'bul bar bgyi/ zhes sogs dang / de ltar maṇ+ḍal dbul nas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ /khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na/ /khyed kyis slob mar bzung ba dang / /cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol/ /de rnams kyi sgo nas rje btsun sgrol ma'i rjes gnang gsan pa yin pas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzod/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ /thob nas nyes pa'i dgra rnams pham byas te/ /skye rga na 'chi'i rba klong 'khrugs pa yi/ /srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro ba 'dren par shog /zhes brjod la slob ma rang gnas su btang / mdun bskyed la mchod bstod gong bzhin 'dod gsol bdag bskyed kyis 'jug bzhin/ rdor sems kyi yig brgya bzlas min skabs sbyar/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang / /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba/ /de kun 'phags mas bzod par mdzod/ /oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/

/rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /badz+ra muḥ tshom bu'i ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /'phags ma sgrol ma 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog /lha dang lha min sogs gong bzhin la/ sgrol ma yum gyi bkra shis shog /zhes sogs ci shes bsnyen pa dang rgyun gyi nyams len ni/ skyabs 'gro nas gdan bsdu ba'i bar byas la/ spro na thun mtshams su/ rje btsun ma mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i zhabs kyi mthe bong rang gi dpral bar reg cing / mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya bdag gi spyi bor bzhag ste byin gyis brlabs/ zhes dang / spro na/ po tā la nas/ 'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog /bar/ yang na/ rgya gar skad du nas/ yi rang gyis bar tshar gcig oṃ dge ma nas/ dbang bdag sras/ bar gsum sogs ci nus/ gzungs ring phreng 'khor sogs ci nus/ de nas/ oṃ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes sogs phyag 'tshal nyer gcig ci 'grub mthar/ lha mo la gus sogs phan yon brjod pa tshar gcig yan lag bdun pa dang 'dod gsol rgyas par bya'am/ yang na/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /zhes sogs gong bzhin/ gtor ma 'bul na phan yon brjod pa rdzogs 'phral zlum gtor chab kyis bran/ 'bul tshul gong bzhin la/ dmigs pa ni po ta la nas rje btsun ma'i ljags kyi 'od zer gyis gtor ma gsol bar bsam/ tshul de lta bu'i sgo nas yi ge bcu pa 'bum phrag bcu gsum mam brgyad cus grangs bsnyen rdzogs pa yin no/ /las tshogs dbang sdud srung 'khor chom rkun srung ba gsum gyi steng du gong gi sgrub thabs rjes gnang gtor ma gsum bsnan pa la yan lag drug par grags shing / sbyin sreg byed na lugs 'di dang rjes su 'brel ba nas kha skong dgos pa ste/
